name: AirAsia Group Berhad (formerly AirAsia X Berhad)
note: AirAsia's listed parent on Bursa Malaysia. It consolidated all of the group's airlines by acquiring 100% of AirAsia Berhad and AirAsia Aviation Group Limited from Capital A in January 2026 (AirAsia statement, 2026-01-06; Journal de l'Aviation, 2026-01-20). Co-founders Tony Fernandes and Kamarudin Meranun remain substantial shareholders via direct and indirect interests (AirAsia statement, 2026-01-06).
